name: Love Others
overview: Scripture calls believers to love others as a reflection of God's love demonstrated through Christ. Jesus commands us to love one another with the same selfless and sacrificial love He showed, emphasizing kindness, tenderheartedness, and forgiveness as essential expressions of this love. This command flows from the greatest love of all—loving God wholeheartedly—and is rooted in the reality that God loved the world so deeply that He gave His only Son to grant eternal life to those who believe.
